strengths: 44px touch targets confirmed on every interactive control: footer buttons, chronicle/constellation links, tab strip, delete confirm, eulogy tap zones — one-handed use is viable throughout
Pace pulse-dot is a genuinely elegant liveness cue: the breathing dot in the footer tells you time is moving without any text; amber + 1s cycle in fast-forward mode reads instantly as 'racing'
Fast-forward (tap the flow text) cycles cleanly between three states — paused / normal / fast — with the amber colour change as the only feedback needed; no menu required
Cold-start confirmation hint ('Continuing House X — Nth of the line, age N.') lingers 9 seconds so a returning player immediately knows where they are without opening the chronicle

The new first-gen dynasty hint ('Everything this life gathers — its name, its means, its standing — will pass to the one who comes after') fires at exactly the right moment (after 2nd decision, gen 1) and resolves the biggest cold-start confusion for casual players: why the choices feel permanent
Sticky dismiss buttons (#loadBack, #chronClose) with a fade gradient ensure 'Back'/'Return' is always reachable on a short phone screen — no scrolling required
Choice hints auto-revealed on touch devices (@media hover:none) so one-handed tapping reveals the hint text that desktop users only see on hover — no feature loss on mobile
The 'how things stand' readout is number-free prose with revised tier text that reads as natural sentences; a casual player gets useful feedback without feeling like they opened a stat screen
Safe-area-inset padding in the footer protects the controls from notch/home-bar overlap on modern phones
The code backup textarea uses user-select:all at 13px — one tap selects the whole code on mobile, which matters for a player who actually wants to preserve their dynasty

improvements.what: Add min-height:44px to the .reflect button rule (currently only has padding:5px 13px with no explicit min-height)
improvements.why: The reflect button is the one new-cycle control that still misses the 44px touch target standard; it is small enough that one-handed tapping at the top of the stage area is occasionally imprecise

improvements.what: On the eulogy screen, show the dynasty's current seat/standing as one short line before the heir button — e.g. 'The house now holds a comfortable household.'
improvements.why: Casual players in burst sessions may miss the Chronicle entirely; a single inherited-standing line at the transition moment rewards the dynasty investment without requiring them to open a panel

improvements.what: Surface the fast-forward control with a one-time hint after the first long quiet stretch (e.g. sinceCard >= 5 and no card drawn), similar to how seenChron is hinted
improvements.why: The flow text doubles as a pace control but a casual first-session player may never discover it; they may just watch years tick and wonder if the game is broken

verdict: The mobile foundation holds firmly — 44px targets, pulse liveness, fast-forward, cold-start and dynasty hints all verified intact — and the new gen-1 dynasty hint meaningfully closes the biggest casual comprehension gap; score unchanged at 8.4.
